data.body_html:
Experience the thrill of the F1 Grand Prix from the Mediterranean with a marbella yacht charter f1 grand prix 2031. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet of luxury yachts offers front-row seats to the race, combined with the comfort of your own private vessel. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours, including skipper, drinks, and snacks.

Why Choose a Yacht for the F1 Grand Prix?

Watching the race from a yacht gives you unparalleled views of the circuit and the coastline. You avoid the crowds and enjoy personalised service. Our yachts anchor near the action, letting you see the cars roar past while sipping cava. It's a premium experience that combines speed on land with luxury at sea.

Our Fleet for the 2031 Race Weekend

We offer a range of yachts from 6.4m to 29m, accommodating 5 to 12 passengers. All depart from Puerto Banús, just minutes from the F1 circuit. Below is a selection of popular choices:

All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%).

Popular Itineraries for Race Day

Most charters for the F1 weekend combine race viewing with coastal cruising. You can anchor near the circuit, then head towards Marbella's best coastal spots like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Alternatively, cruise to Estepona or Sotogrande for lunch. The skipper will tailor the route to your preferences.

How to Book Your F1 Yacht Charter

Booking is simple. For Tier A and B yachts, use our online system. For all other vessels, contact us via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 2 months in advance for the F1 weekend. Provide your preferred yacht, duration, and number of guests, and we'll confirm availability.
